title: Autoregressive Diffusion World Models for Off-Policy Evaluation of LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.05558v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents in multi-turn interactive environments is expensive and risky, as it requires online environment interaction. We propose ADWM (Autoregressive Diffusion World Model), an evaluation framework that estimates the performance of a new LLM agent policy purely from pre-collected trajectories. The core idea is to learn a latent diffusion world model that simulates how the environment responds to the evaluation policy, without ever executing it in the real environment. Existing diffusion-based OPE methods guide full trajectories in a single pass by jointly diffusing states and actions, an assumption that breaks down for LLM agents whose actions are discrete text that must be sampled from the policy after observing the environment. translated_title: 用于大语言模型智能体离线策略评估的自回归扩散世界模型
translated_abstract: 在多轮交互环境中评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体成本高昂且存在风险，因为这需要在线的环境交互。我们提出了ADWM（自回归扩散世界模型），这是一个评估框架，能够仅从预先收集的轨迹中估计新的LLM智能体策略的性能。其核心思想是学习一个潜在扩散世界模型来模拟环境对被评估策略的响应，而无需在真实环境中执行该策略。现有的基于扩散的离线策略评估（OPE）方法通过联合扩散状态和动作来一次性引导完整轨迹，这一假设对于LLM智能体会失效，因为LLM智能体的动作是离散文本，必须在观察环境后从策略中采样得到。与遭受复合误差困扰的自回归世界模型不同，ADWM将每个状态转移建模为独立的去噪过程，从而实现可靠的逐步（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出自回归扩散世界模型ADWM，通过潜在扩散模拟环境响应，仅凭预先收集的轨迹即可离线评估LLM智能体策略性能，避免了昂贵的在线交互并克服了自回归世界模型的复合误差问题。
en_tdlr: ADWM is an autoregressive diffusion world model that enables off-policy evaluation of LLM agents purely from pre-collected trajectories by simulating environment responses via latent diffusion, avoiding costly online interaction while overcoming the compounding errors of autoregressive world models.
